newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich March securities turnover falls 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich March securities turnover falls 11.1 pct.

text.p: Securities turnover in Switzerland's biggest canton, Zurich, fell 11.1 pct in March from the month before to 65.16 billion Swiss francs, cantonal bourse authorities said.
Turnover was up 5.6 percent from March of 1996.
Cumulative turnover for 1997 was 23.4 percent higher than the year before at 207.9 billion francs.
The figures cover all trade in securities and securities derivatives on and off the bourse and on the Swiss Options and Financial Futures Exchange (Soffex). -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
